title: How Adam Robinson turned LinkedIn into RB2B's only channel: pillars, hooks, credibility
summary: Adam explains how a year of posting on LinkedIn before seeing any direct revenue built a founder brand that became RB2B's sole acquisition channel (about $5M ARR in 13 months). He covers content pillars and content-market fit, hook writing, credibility signals, why video deepens trust, and why he skips AI-written posts and viral-for-followers tactics.

principles.text: Posting on LinkedIn means building a public figure: repeat the same few content pillars in many different ways.
principles.quote: what you are doing when you are consistently posting on LinkedIn is you are creating a public figure as a PR agency would have created a public figure in the media 50 years ago.

principles.text: Find content-market fit: pick 2-3 authentic, non-mainstream pillars that resonate with your market.
principles.quote: you've got to come up with two or three things that are authentic to you that resonate with the market that are not down the middle mainstream.

principles.text: The hook matters most; a mediocre post with a great hook beats a great post with a weak hook. Use numbers.
principles.quote: a mediocre post with a great hook will do far better than a great hook, sorry, a great post with a weak hook.

principles.text: Treat every post as if no one knows you and build credibility into each one, since audience overlap between posts is low.
principles.quote: you have to treat each post as though no one has ever heard of you before. So each post has to maximize the credibility of you every time.

principles.text: Optimize for trust within your ICP, not raw follower count; broad viral topics build a crowd, not buyers.
principles.quote: I'm trying to maximize the trust in like the real audience that I have within my ICP, right?

principles.text: Early posting is about finding your voice, not engagement or deals; keep going through the no-revenue stretch.
principles.quote: starting to post on social is not about engagement and deals and dollars. It's about being one day closer to finding your voice.
